pages.caption: Tournament Bracket
pages.title: Tournament Bracket Maker — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable tournament bracket. Pick the number of teams (4, 8, 16, 32 and more), type player or team names into each slot, then print — or save as a PDF. No download or signup.
pages.blurb: A ready-to-fill single-elimination tournament bracket. Set how many teams or players are entered, type names straight into each slot, and the rounds redraw automatically all the way to the champion.
pages.tip: Odd team counts are handled with first-round byes, so 6, 12, or any number still lays out cleanly. Switch to double elimination or change the field size from the controls above before you print.

pages.caption: Double-Elimination Bracket
pages.title: Double-Elimination Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable double-elimination bracket with a winners bracket, losers bracket, and grand final. Choose 4, 8, 16, or 32 teams, fill in names, and print or save as a PDF.
pages.blurb: A full double-elimination bracket: every entrant has to lose twice to be knocked out. The sheet shows the winners bracket up top, the losers bracket below, and a grand final that decides the champion.
pages.tip: Double elimination needs a full power-of-two field (4, 8, 16, 32). Switch to single elimination or change the size from the controls, then print in landscape for the roomiest layout.

pages.caption: 4-Team Bracket
pages.title: 4-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 4-team single-elimination bracket: two semifinals and a final. Type in names, then print or save as a PDF. No download or signup.
pages.blurb: A clean 4-team bracket — two semifinal matchups feeding one final and a champion slot. Perfect for a quick knockout among four players or teams.
pages.tip: Need more entrants? Bump the team count from the controls above and the bracket redraws instantly, or switch to double elimination for a second-chance format.

pages.caption: 6-Team Bracket
pages.title: 6-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 6-team bracket. The top two seeds get first-round byes, then it runs down to a champion. Fill in names and print or save as a PDF.
pages.blurb: A 6-team single-elimination bracket. Six isn't a power of two, so the two top seeds receive first-round byes and jump straight to the semifinals — the bracket handles the seeding for you.
pages.tip: Byes are marked automatically in round one. Change the number of teams from the controls above to build any size bracket you need.

pages.caption: 8-Team Bracket
pages.title: 8-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 8-team single-elimination bracket: quarterfinals, semifinals, and a final. Type in team names, then print or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: The classic 8-team bracket — four quarterfinals, two semifinals, one final, and a champion. Type each team or player into its slot and print a clean sheet to track the whole tournament.
pages.tip: Want a losers bracket too? Switch to double elimination from the controls above, or scale up to 16 or 32 teams with one click.

pages.caption: 16-Team Bracket
pages.title: 16-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 16-team single-elimination bracket with four rounds down to a champion. Fill in names and print in landscape, or save as a PDF. No signup.
pages.blurb: A full 16-team bracket: a round of 16, quarterfinals, semifinals, and the final. Seeds are laid out in standard order so the top seeds only meet late.
pages.tip: Print in landscape so all four rounds fit across the page. Switch to double elimination or resize the field from the controls above.

pages.caption: 32-Team Bracket
pages.title: 32-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 32-team single-elimination bracket, five rounds down to a champion. Fill in names, scale the text to fit, and print in landscape or save as a PDF.
pages.blurb: A large 32-team bracket with five rounds from the round of 32 to the final. The text scales down when printing so the whole field still fits on a single landscape page.
pages.tip: Use landscape and, if your printer offers it, 'fit to page'. Drop down to 16 teams or switch formats from the controls above.

pages.caption: 3-Team Bracket
pages.title: 3-Team Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: Free printable 3-team bracket. The top seed gets a first-round bye straight to the final. Fill in names and print or save as a PDF.
pages.blurb: A 3-team bracket: with an odd number of entrants the top seed draws a first-round bye and advances directly to the final, where it meets the winner of the other two.
pages.tip: The bye is placed and labelled automatically. Add more teams from the controls above to grow the bracket to any size.

pages.caption: Tournament Bracket
pages.title: Blank Tournament Bracket — Free Printable (PDF)
pages.desc: A blank printable tournament bracket to fill in by hand or on screen. Pick any size (4, 8, 16, 32), type or write in the names, then print or save as a PDF.
pages.blurb: A blank bracket with empty write-on lines for every slot — no names filled in. Set the size, then either type entrants on screen or print it empty and pencil them in.
pages.tip: Every name line is click-to-type. Choose your field size and single or double elimination from the controls above before printing.
